# Key Findings (auto-generated)

Factual rollup of the current feature dataset. Interpretation lives in the final report.

## Overview
- Posts: 35,236 across 2 platforms (youtube: 30,140, instagram: 5,096).
- Content date range: 2016-04-20 to 2026-08-16.

## Sentiment by platform (English)
- instagram: positive 85.5%, neutral 7.5%, negative 7.1%.
- youtube: positive 63.4%, neutral 21.1%, negative 15.4%.

## Engagement vs sentiment
- Avg engagement percentile by sentiment: negative 0.493, neutral 0.494, positive 0.507 (spread 0.014).
- Relationship is essentially flat (sentiment does not predict engagement).

## Dominant topics (by volume)
- T3: time, real, new, think - 17,385 posts.
- T0: business, help, build, digitalmarketing - 4,869 posts.
- T8: understand, easy, easy understand, simple - 1,625 posts.
- T7: rich, broke, smart, dumb - 1,428 posts.
- T4: free, free praise, praise, paid - 1,064 posts.

## Emerging vs declining topics (recent vs earlier in window)
- Rising: T6: chat, gpt, chat gpt, voice (+0.99 pts).
- Rising: T5: start, ready, right, scratch (+0.4 pts).
- Rising: T7: rich, broke, smart, dumb (+0.29 pts).
- Declining: T3: time, real, new, think (-0.55 pts).
- Declining: T8: understand, easy, easy understand, simple (-0.64 pts).

## Top keywords (by volume)
- ChatGPT - 6,087 posts.
- AI Agents - 4,827 posts.

## Models
- Production sentiment model: vader (deploy-domain macro-F1 0.6493).
- Topic model: NMF, k=9, UMass coherence -1.1043 (more coherent than LDA).
